game.name: Jumper : Griffin's Story (USA, Europe)
game.desc: Jumper: Griffin's Story is the Xbox 360 video game adaptation of the film Jumper. You play as Griffin, one of the Jumpers who has the power to teleport, pursued by the Paladins who are desperate to exterminate those with this power. Escape from the organisation and fight against numerous enemies. Take revenge on your belligerents and restore your family's image.
